whenToUse: This skill should be used when the user asks to "add a hover/press effect", "animate a toggle or switch", "build an animated like button", "make a toast/snackbar slide in", "animate a drawer or modal", "animate list reordering or add/remove
Hover/press/focus feedback; toggles, checkboxes, like/heart buttons
List add/remove/reorder; shared-element ("magic move") layout transitions
verification: One .html file: your markup plus either CSS transitions/@starting-style or an inline <script type="module"> importing motion from CDN.
A way to land on the resolved end state for a screenshot — interactions are state-driven, not time-driven, so freeze the state rather than a clock.
Opens standalone — no console errors, CDN React/motion (if used) resolves.
The ?state= (or controlled-prop) freeze lands a deterministic, settled state.
Screenshotted across states — idle / active / open — matches the brief, no artifacts.
prefers-reduced-motion honored — large movement dropped, opacity/feedback kept.
Easing is intentional — enter ease-out, exit ease-in, durations in the 100–250ms band.
